question: Give a 2024 global EV market snapshot.
analyzed_text: 2024 global EV market snapshot. Worldwide EV unit sales: About 17.1 million electric vehicles were sold globally in 2024 (battery-electric + plug-in hybrid), up from roughly 13.9 million in 2023. Top 3 manufacturers by EV volume: 1. BYD: 4.27 million vehicles. 2. Tesla: 1.79 million vehicles delivered. 3. Geely Group: ~1.49 million new-energy vehicles. Average lithium-ion battery pack price: The 2024 global average fell to $115 per kWh, a sharp year-over-year decline. Tesla annual revenue: Tesla reported $97.7 billion in 2024 revenue. China's share of global EV production: China accounted for roughly 70% of global EV production in 2024, maintaining its dominant manufacturing position. Battery recycling: Battery recycling expanded quickly in 2024, with leading processes now able to recover over 90% of key metals such as nickel, cobalt, and lithium, improving supply security and reducing raw-material intensity. Overall, 2024 was another record year for EVs: sales kept growing, battery costs fell materially, China remained the production hub, and recycling became a more important part of the industry's economics.

verdict.summary: 2 of 3 checkable claims hold up. 1 has a wrong amount. 2 could not be checked against reliable sources.

claims.verdict: Contradicted: amount (sources say 1.49 million, growing 52 percent compared with 2023)
